units.text: I started vibration measuring on the 12 most critical conveyor motors and I set limits when the bearings must be changed. Unplanned stops on the line went down 30% in next 6 months.
I helped the automation engineer when the packing line was upgraded, and I helped with testing when they asked.
The quality team wrote new final inspection criteria, with photos of OK and not OK welds. Defect rate in final inspection went down 40% in 6 months.
